## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew assembleDevDebug testDevDebugUnitTest lintDevDebug` passes
- [ ] A test covers the logic, or a fixed bug has a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Every new control has a label, and I checked it with TalkBack
- [ ] New strings are in `values/strings.xml`
- [ ] No analytics, tracking or new network calls (or discussed in an issue first)
- [ ] New dependencies or models are MIT-compatible and listed in the notices
